messages:
julia: FYI seeing a spike in staging where new SSO logins without eduPersonAffiliation get assigned org_admin by JIT. Noticed after this morning's role-mapping change. :rotating_light:

samir: can you paste a sample SAML assertion and the matching rule evaluation?

julia: pasted an anonymized assertion below — attribute is absent, and our mapping rule appears to treat empty as truthy. Repro steps: 1) SSO into staging with account that lacks eduPersonAffiliation 2) user created via JIT 3) assigned roles = [org_admin]

```xml
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <!-- eduPersonAffiliation missing -->
  <saml:Attribute Name="email">
    <saml:AttributeValue>tester@example.com</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name="displayName">
    <saml:AttributeValue>QA Tester</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

kiran: looks like the mapping rule in prod/staging has a fallback expression that does `if (!attr) default_role` but our evaluator treats the empty node differently. I think the condition logic got inverted in the refactor (PR #4412).

julia: confirmed — PR 4412 changed eval semantics when attribute is missing vs empty string. I can repro locally by removing the attribute and hitting the mapping service: it returns org_admin.

ops-bot: Audit event logged: user=qa.tester staging, event=jit_provision, role_assigned=org_admin, trace=trace-9a3f

samir: tagging @eve-security for risk assessment. If production has same rule, we should assume elevated access for some users. Eve, how urgent?

eve-security: high. Can we scope this to staging only? If not, treat as P1 and revoke generated admin roles immediately until fix. Also need to check audit logs for last 48h for similar JIT assigns.

kiran: plan: 1) revert PR 4412 mapping logic change (hotfix) 2) add explicit presence check `attr !== undefined && attr !== ''` 3) run quick canary on staging then promote 4) schedule audit query for 48h window. I can open a rollback and a follow-on PR.

julia: opened ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4521 with repro, logs, and suggested patch diff. I ran a one-off query and found 7 staging users affected.

deploy-bot: deploy request created for hotfix branch fix/sso-mapping-4412 -> staging at 2401234700 by kiran. CI: passed.

samir: after hotfix lands, run a script to demote any non-service accounts created with org_admin in last 48 hours and notify owners. Use audit trace to find source.

kiran: ack. I'll run the demotion script against staging now and prepare the prod run only after we confirm mapping behavior. Script snippet: `node tools/demote_jit_admins.js --since 48h --env staging --confirm`

julia: sounds good. Postmortem items: add unit tests for missing/empty attributes, update mapping docs, and add a monitor alert when >1 JIT admin created in 1h.

eve-security: also request a KMS audit: some of these JIT events had encrypted metadata — ensure KMS rotation logs show no failures. I'll open SEC-4522 for that follow-up.

samir: thanks team. Keep updates in THREAD. If any sign of production impact, escalate oncall immediately (@ops-bot). :thumbsup:
